What’s New in Asda Rewards

We’ve made a few updates to keep your app running smoothly:

• Clearer Updates: A fresh look for service notifications, making key info easy to spot. 
• Sleeker Design: Tidied up tooltips, spacing, and layouts across the app. 
• Improved Usability: Access your Cashpot directly from the Offers or Wallet tab by tapping your balance.
• Bug Fixes: Minor behind-the-scenes polish for a reliable experience.

Update now and start saving!
results.description:
Save more on your shop with Asda Rewards - complete Missions, unlock instant money-off coupons, and convert your Cashpot balance into shopping vouchers.

Take a fresh look at Asda Rewards. Designed to make your money go further, our app brings together personalised shopping bonuses, instant wallet savings, and iconic Rollback prices across thousands of items in-store and online.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE ASDA REWARDS

COMPLETE MISSIONS & BUILD YOUR CASHPOT

• Shopping Challenges: Complete fun Missions to unlock Cashpot earnings and boost your balance.
• Scan & Collect: Present your barcode at checkout when you shop to complete Missions and drop savings straight into your Cashpot.

UNLOCK INSTANT COUPONS

• Digital Wallet Discounts: Check your app wallet regularly for new money-off coupons ready to use across your shop.
• Effortless Savings: Redeem coupons in seconds by scanning them at the till alongside your Rewards barcode.

TURN YOUR EARNINGS INTO VOUCHERS

• In-Store & Online: Convert your Cashpot balance into vouchers to spend in Asda stores and online at Asda.com.
• Custom Amounts: Pick your exact voucher amount and generate it in seconds.
• Good to Know: You have 6 months from the month earned to convert your savings before they expire.

EASE THE LOAD WITH CHRISTMAS SAVER

• Save for the Season: Move your earnings into your dedicated Christmas Saver Cashpot up until 15th November.
• Locked & Protected: Your festive funds stay safely locked away, so they won't expire or get spent early.

GAMES, COMPETITIONS & EXTRA PRIZES

• In-App Games: Play seasonal games to score extra rewards, including coupons and Cashpot earnings.
• Regular Giveaways: Enter competitions for your chance to grab exclusive prizes.

SMARTER, SIMPLER SHOPPING

• Explore Rollback: Save on over 14,000 products in-store and online.
• Personalised Home Screen: Enjoy a fresh, clear layout built around how you shop.
• Effortless Saving: Get tailored prompts so you always know how to make the most of your app experience.
• Optimised Barcode: Scan quickly at checkout straight from the app, or save your card to your Apple Wallet.
• Push Notifications: Turn on alerts for instant Mission reminders, new reward drops, and important updates.

GETTING STARTED IS SIMPLE

• Register or Log In: Sign up in seconds or log in with your existing Asda account to automatically link online orders.
• Scan & Shop: Present your app barcode in-store, or for online shopping, simply log in using the same email address as your Rewards account.

Download Asda Rewards today and start saving on your shop.

To find out more information about Asda Rewards, visit our website: www.asda.com/rewards

FAQs & HELP

Q: How do I link my accounts?
A: Use the same email address for your online grocery account and Asda Rewards. They will link automatically so you can start earning online immediately.

Q: Do I earn Cashpot rewards on every purchase?
A: You build your Cashpot by completing specific Missions, rather than earning on every single item.

Q: What should I do if I have trouble signing in?
A: Ensure your connection is stable and try signing in again. Setting Google Chrome as your default mobile browser usually resolves any remaining login issues.

Q: What if my phone number isn't accepted at registration?
A: Your number may need to be reset in our system. Contact our Customer Support team on 0330 053 0222 and they will update it for you.
